top_findings.title: MCP tools advertise empty inputSchema, so required args are undiscoverable
top_findings.evidence: src/server.ts:15 maps all 6 tools to inputSchema {type:object, additionalProperties:true} with no properties/required; src/server.ts:20-22 then mandate args. A schema-driven MCP client builds args from the schema, gets {}, and the server rejects it with error -32602. _factual.json score 0.0. Underlying logic is correct (service.standings('Brasileirao',2019) -> Flamengo 38 played / 90 pts / pos 1, 20 clubs).
top_findings.suggestion: Give each tool a real JSON Schema with properties and a required[] list so clients can discover mandatory arguments.

note: SECOND OPINION re-score. First evaluation scored requirement_coverage=0.9167 by marking R1 (MCP server) not met; corrected to 1.0 (12/12) — the MCP server entrypoint + 6 registered tool definitions exist (src/server.ts:8-29), satisfying R1's how_to_verify. The empty-inputSchema defect is real (F1, critical) but is a quality/interface defect, not a missing requirement; it fails the separate factual_accuracy gate (0.0), which is why the run fails overall. min_severity=high, so medium/info findings excluded from counts.
